pages.text: $(l)Blast furnace does nothing$()$(br)Below $(item)3 full layers$() it does nothing at all. The goggles show its height: a missing corner or edge brick shortens it.
$(l)Coke oven paused$()$(br)Its CO2 tank is full. CO2 only leaves through the $(item)top face$(); pipe it from there.$(br2)$(l)Distillation tower does nothing$()

The number of $(item)Distillation Outputs must equal the number of products$() of the recipe, with an Industrial Pipe between each output. The steel tank must be at least $(item)twice as tall$() as the number of outputs, and $(item)2 wide$() when there are more than 3 outputs. Heat it from below.

The Pumpjack Base looks straight down for the oil deposit through an unbroken column of $(item)Industrial Pipes$(). Any other block in the column, or a column that misses the deposit, makes it invalid. Find the deposit with the surface scanner first, then pipe straight down to it.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
